content: Foundry IQ—formerly Azure AI Search—now offers generally available semantic chunking and optional AI-generated image descriptions through the Azure Content Understanding skill. The skill uses document structure to create chunks with Markdown and location metadata. Configure a supported chat-model deployment to generate descriptions of supported images, charts, and diagrams. Learn more.
